Management expects to end FY25 with good growth over FY24
Jewellery EBIT margin guidance of 11% to 11.5% on standalone annualized basis

11% EBIT margin seen as threshold on annualized basis; unlikely to go below except in extreme situations

Targeting healthy double-digit jewellery growth (15-20%) for FY26
Tanishq store opening guidance of 40-50 new stores for FY26

Gross margins impacted by product mix shift and gold price effect on studded margins
Watches EBIT margin expected at mid-teens for FY26

Jewellery one-time benefit of 50 bps from hedging MTM will reverse in Q2 and Q3

Tanishq store expansion plans for FY26 remain strong, catch-up expected in Q2 before festive season
TEAL automation solutions doing EV-related work; Justech acquisition adding product-like revenue stream
Gold coin share elevated but not extraordinary vs prior quarters; margin flat excluding one-offs

Jewellery EBIT growth may be slightly slower than revenue growth for full year due to margin headwinds from gold prices; aim to keep margins in stable range

EyeCare added 2 Runway stores (net) in Q3FY26

Store expansion continues robustly for Mia and CaratLane given positive outlook on younger customer demand

Jewellery revenue growth guidance of 15-20% CAGR over next 3-5 years
Investor Day planned for first week of June to provide more guidance
Jewellery domestic EBIT margin 11-11.5% band sustainability uncertain if gold prices rise further
Margin pressure primarily from product mix shift to coins, plain gold and diamond, not discounting
Damas international business profitable at operating level for full year, Q4 loss Rs82 cr due to GCC unrest
Taneira store expansion paused for operating model review focusing on same-store growth, buyer growth, stock turns
Margin sustainability easier if gold prices stabilize at current levels

CaratLane added 11 domestic stores (net) in Q1FY27

MTM inventory gain of 75-80 bps in jewellery division EBIT expected to reverse over next 2-3 quarters

Gross margin expansion initiatives include lower caratage, GC Max program, and sourcing strategies; details not disclosed
Targeting double-digit aggressive growth in jewellery; FY30 goals unchanged
TEAL normalized margin gravitating towards 12-16% long-term; CaratLane targeting double-digit EBIT margin (~10%)
Prioritizing top-line growth over margins in TEAL and CaratLane; both on significant growth path
Committed to double-digit healthy value growth in jewellery to achieve FY30 goals; not carried away by quarterly volatility
